hint.orderEmpty: empty: in a stack general ones first, in a fixed queue at random
hint.pickEmpty: empty: at random, weaker ones more often
hint.path: field keys, one per line: authors, then birthplace
hint.kindOfEntry: empty: the kind of this entry
hint.allOfKind: empty: all entries of the kind
hint.translationWords: e.g. the words of a translation
hint.leftField: e.g. a fragment; empty: the entry's thesis
hint.distractorFrom: field · scope · list · near — one per line
hint.randomList: one item per line; a list from the left counts too
hint.howManyDifferent: empty: one; e.g. 4 — four different ones, no repeats
hint.let: [{"name": "v", "value": "s / t"}, {"name": "wzor", "value": "this.symbol + sub(n)"}] — this: this card's entry
hint.require: one per line, e.g. isint(v) — draws again, at most 60 times
hint.texts: [{"name": "pytanie", "value": "What is {a} + {b}?"}] — each text has its own output
hint.only: e.g. this.ladunek > 0 — other entries of the kind get no card (without a warning)
hint.expr: one per line or after “;”: p0 + 1 · mod(p0, p1) · round(p0 / 3, 2) · fmt(p0, 2); p0, p1 … — the number from an input, n0, n1 … — how many values came
hint.fromAll: empty: from this base and all sources
hint.oneLevel: unticked: to the very end, all levels
hint.oneStep: unticked: down to the very basics (or to the end)
hint.endWhenDone: unticked (by what I know): then it keeps teaching ahead — what you know least
hint.detour: or a story from another world (always optional)
hint.detourLabel: e.g. Want to know more: the house in Becchi without a father
hint.skipWhen: If the condition holds, the story goes straight on — no slide where nothing is left to decide. Example: the learner knows the topic, or answered its question in the last 7 days.
hint.holdOne: Normally a choice with one valid option takes it by itself. Tick this to show the choice anyway.

f.filterValue: Value when nothing comes into “Compare with”
f.hasValue: … has the value (when nothing comes into “Where field has”)
f.leftValue: Left side when nothing comes in
f.rightValue: Right side when nothing comes in
f.relative: Tolerance as a fraction of the value
f.radius: Radius (m or part of the image)
f.back: Backwards: to what points to these entries
f.keepStart: Also keep the entries it starts from
f.stackSize: Cards at once in the stack
f.endWhenDone: End when nothing is waiting for review and nothing is new
f.title: Heading (flow data)
f.question: Question
f.says: What they say (a statement — block content)
f.holdOne: Stop even when only one option is left

opt.before: backwards — what must be known first
